body.focus: Run each build-gate test file in the gate's own process (no `--test`), keeping `--test-force-exit`, so its TAP report is never truncated (ISSUE-7ba8cf15). Change TEST_RUNNER_ARGV in src/mcp/build-step/validation-checks.ts; add a regression test.
body.summary: TEST_RUNNER_ARGV drops `--test`, so each file runs in the runner's own process with force-exit kept. The TAP report goes to a per-run file through `--test-reporter-destination`, and the process's own output is appended as TAP comments, so a printed result line is never read as one. Review follow-up: if that report file cannot be created, the file's check now fails with a note instead of the gate throwing. Regression tests cover a 300-test file reported in full, a failing test, and the report directory not being creatable.
